title: Ticket Stubs That Learned to Ride
youtube_title: Ticket Stubs That Learned to Ride | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Scraps can become a true picture when you give them a place in the story.
summary: Vito tips out old ticket stubs and pastes them into memory pictures of the train, the bus, and the tethered balloon, leaving one blank scrap for a ride he has not taken.
